name: @jarroba/mcp
description: MCP server (stdio, local) exposing 134 deterministic tools from Jarroba Tools, reusing the same code as the web app: read a CI log that does not fit in your context, audit tests, simulate make, run SQL against an ephemeral PostgreSQL, SPARQL, JTD diagrams rendered without a browser, arithmetic with UNITS and dimensional checking, equations and calculation sheets, identity/RBAC reasoning across Azure/AWS/GCP/Kubernetes, simulate an architecture (load, queues, bottleneck, cost), audit another MCP server's catalogue, plus the usual CIDR/hash/JWT/token/regex a model gets wrong. Nothing leaves your machine. Smaller focused packages: @jarroba/mcp-logs, @jarroba/mcp-tests, @jarroba/mcp-calc.
